note: A page constructing a BarcodeDetector must not kill the app (W6-D31): the WebView's shape-detection binding runs the Play services client's manifest check, which threw across the JNI boundary on the in-process GPU thread. The crash needs the Chromium snapshot WebView (the images' WebView 113 did not show it) and no form factor - the driver taps by the page's own geometry and asserts nothing about layout - so it rides the tablet-webview shard (pixel_tablet 1280x800@160), which has the room the webview shard has not (67 of 68 minutes); its own workflow's job records the phone, pixel_6. On the AOSP image detect() rejects NotSupportedError; the process lives.
